title: NEW (defect in the W5' fix): the rail press-swallow dead-zones the two right tray chips — router_mid/router_high paint over the plate but their clicks are eaten
evidence: main.odin:1201-1202: `if app.overlay_on && rnd.noc_panel_hit(rnd.noc_panel_rect(app.view.win_w, app.view.win_h), pos) { return true }` (the fix's own comment claims 'the clickable surfaces — QoS, tray, chip, popover — are all inside the playfield'). tray.odin:48: `x0 := (f32(v.win_w) - total_w) / 2` — the tray is win_w-centered, NOT play_w-anchored. mouse.odin:305: `// swallowed — no tray, no drag (the base gate)`. Geometry from the shipped catalogs (3 pipe tiers + 3 junctions = 6 chips, TRAY_CHIP_W 96 / GAP 8): chips span 332..948 at y 684..710; the plate starts at x=756 — chip 4 (router_mid, 748..844) and chip 5 (router_high, 852..948) lie over the plate. draw_hud (main.odin:759, draw_tray at 1567) runs AFTER draw_noc_overlay (717-721), so the chips are visibly painted over the plate (confirmed in the shipped after-rail-real-run.png) yet unclickable while D is on.
detail: The W5' swallow assumes every clickable surface is inside the playfield, but the r1-W1 decision kept the bottom band at win_w. Two visible router chips over the plate are dead while D is on — a player-facing input regression on a shipped runtime surface.
recommended_fix: Hit-test the tray chips before the rail swallow (or subtract tray_chip_rects from the swallowed area), or re-anchor the tray to play_w while the rail is on.

title: Claimed-all-fixed but r2 N5' persists: noc_panel_rect's 'single source' comment still contradicts draw_noc_panel re-deriving the plate as px - NOC_PLATE_PAD
evidence: line 364: `// The hit-test + the draw share it (single source — the tests pin the rect).` / lines 628-629: `rl.DrawRectangle(px - NOC_PLATE_PAD, 0, NOC_RAIL_W, v.win_h, NOC_PLATE)` and `rl.DrawRectangleLines(px - NOC_PLATE_PAD, 0, NOC_RAIL_W, v.win_h, NOC_PLATE_EDGE)` — the draw never calls noc_panel_rect.

title: W4' fix is partial: only camera_update is pinned at rail-on geometry — the zoom/pan/pullback play_w threading the finding named remains unpinned (the asked-for zoom clamp assert is missing)
evidence: the only rail-on app-layer leg: `camera_update_centers_on_the_playfield_with_the_rail :: proc(t: ^testing.T) { ... rnd.view_set_rail(&app.view, true) / camera_update(&app) ...}` — `grep -n view_set_rail app/pullback_test.odin` returns only line 223; no test sets the rail for camera_zoom_at/effect_pan/pullback_feed, which thread play_w at main.odin:1874-1875 (`rnd.camera_anchor_center(..., f32(v.play_w), ...)` / `rnd.camera_clamp_center(..., f32(v.play_w), ...)`), 1902 (pan clamp) and 1813 (pullback target).
detail: r2 W4' named four call sites and its recommended fix asked for 'camera_update + a zoom clamp assert'; the fix commit pins camera_update only. The three remaining play_w call sites could revert to win_w and stay green.
recommended_fix: Add one rail-on leg through camera_zoom_at (clamp keeps the world east edge <= play_w) or explicitly accept + document the residual in the PR body.
